preconditions.name: ARM_FULL::episode_outcome_spread_supra_floor
preconditions.description: MECH-323's evaluative gate is RELATIVE to a running baseline, so formation is structurally impossible on a flat outcome stream. Same statistic 810a's own gate asserts (population stdev of the per-episode outcome).
preconditions.control: worst of the 3 probed seeds on this identical task config

preconditions.name: ARM_FULL::chunk_buffer_supports_size_range
preconditions.description: note_outcome breaks out at len(actions) < size, so a per-trial buffer shorter than chunk_max_size makes the size budget structurally unreachable. Same statistic 810a's own gate asserts (recorded symbols per trial).
preconditions.control: worst of the 3 probed seeds on this identical task config

preconditions.name: ARM_FULL::salient_harm_events_fire
preconditions.description: MECH-091's clock.phase_reset() fires only on harm_signal < 0, and the full-loop de-periodisation is what makes the committed-action stream informative at all. Same statistic 810a's own gate asserts (fraction of env steps with negative harm_signal).
preconditions.control: worst of the 3 probed seeds on this identical task config
